Entry.en-US:
Hello, Old World! The Community Tournament returns for Season 3 — a series of one-on-one Network Duels open to all players. Battle through the Swiss qualifiers, advance to the Championship Bracket, and crown a champion. Registration is open until June 30 2026. To join the action:
  • Join the Discord
  • Sign up on our tournament site Per Ankh
  • Read the Rules
    • Whether you’re new to Old World Multiplayer or a seasoned duelist, we'd love to have you join us!
